# Pixelbrahma: full content summary

Last updated: 2026-11-12

## Web Design, App Development, Digital Marketing and Branding Agency
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/

Pixelbrahma is a design and technology studio with offices in Bengaluru, Kochi and Brampton that builds apps and websites, runs digital marketing and creates brands. With more than 20 years of experience, we help startups and growing businesses in India and Canada with web design, mobile app development, social media marketing and branding.

**What services does Pixelbrahma offer?**
Pixelbrahma offers website design and development, mobile app development, digital marketing (social media management and content creation) and branding, including logo design, brochures, leaflets, magazines, package design, in-shop branding, outdoor advertising and TV commercials.

**Do you offer web design and app development in Bengaluru and Kochi?**
Yes. Our studios in Kasturinagar, Bengaluru and Kadavanthara, Kochi design and build websites and mobile apps for businesses across India.

**Do you work with businesses in Canada?**
Yes. Our Brampton office supports businesses in the Greater Toronto Area and across Canada with web design, app development, digital marketing and branding.

**How much does a website, app or branding project cost?**
The cost depends on scope, features and timeline. Send a short brief through the contact form and we will reply with questions and a price range once we understand the goal.

**What does a branding project include?**
A branding project can include positioning, a logo and identity system, and the materials that carry it, such as brochures, leaflets, magazines, packaging, in-shop branding, outdoor advertising and TV commercials.

**Can you manage our social media and run ads?**
Yes. Our digital media managing service covers strategy, platform management, campaign optimisation and monthly analytics, and our content team creates the posts, graphics and videos.

**How do I start a project with Pixelbrahma?**
Send a short brief using the contact form or call us. We will reply with questions and a suggested scope.

**Do you design logos and brand identity?**
Yes. Our logo design service creates a logo, colour palette, typography and a short usage guide, and we can extend the identity into brochures, packaging, signage and more.

**Can you create brochures, leaflets and packaging?**
Yes. We design brochures, leaflets, magazines and product packaging, and supply print-ready artwork for your printer.

**Do you offer outdoor advertising and TV commercial production?**
Yes. We design hoardings, banners and vehicle branding, and we develop and guide the production of TV commercials and video ads.

**What is Smolgoodi?**
Smolgoodi is a product built by Pixelbrahma that helps home sellers in India list products and take orders through a shareable link, with orders arriving on WhatsApp.

## Mobile app development for iOS, Android and the web
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/app-development/

Pixelbrahma develops cross-platform apps that run on iOS, Android and the web from a shared product design, so you reach more users without paying for three separate builds.

**Do I need separate apps for iPhone and Android?**
Not necessarily. A cross-platform approach lets one shared codebase and design system serve both, which usually reduces cost and keeps the experience consistent.

**Can you design the app and build it?**
Yes. Our UI/UX designers and engineers work together, so what is designed is what gets built.

**How do you protect user data?**
We plan encryption, access control and safe storage during architecture, and review dependencies and permissions before every release.

**Will you help publish to the App Store and Google Play?**
Yes. We prepare store listings and assets, handle submissions and guide you through any review feedback.

**What happens after launch?**
You can continue with a monthly team or a maintenance plan covering updates, fixes and improvements.

**How much does mobile app development cost in India?**
The cost depends on the number of screens, the features, the integrations and whether you need an admin panel. We scope every app after a short discovery call and send a written estimate, so you know the range before any design work starts.

**How long does it take to build a mobile app?**
A focused first version usually takes a few months from wireframes to store release, and larger products take longer. We agree a milestone plan up front so you can see progress at every stage.

**Which technologies do you use for cross-platform app development?**
We choose the stack that fits your product, using cross-platform frameworks where they give you one codebase for iOS and Android and native code where performance demands it.

**Do you build apps for startups in Bengaluru, Kochi and Canada?**
Yes. Our teams in Bengaluru, Kochi and Brampton work with startups and established brands, and most projects run through video calls with regular demos.

## Website design and development that earns attention
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/website/

Pixelbrahma designs and develops custom websites with a user-friendly flow, clean code and advanced security, so visitors understand your business quickly and search engines can index it properly.

**How long does a website project take?**
It depends on the number of pages and how quickly content arrives. We confirm a schedule in the proposal once the sitemap is agreed.

**Will my site rank on Google?**
We build the technical and on-page foundations that make ranking possible. Rankings themselves depend on competition, content and links, so we never promise a position.

**Can I update the site myself?**
Yes. We can structure content so you can edit text and images, or we can maintain it for you.

**Do you redesign existing WordPress sites?**
Yes. We map your current URLs and set up redirects so you keep the search value you have already earned.

**How much does a website cost?**
A landing page, a business website and an online store need very different amounts of design and development. We quote after a short discovery call, based on page count, features and content, and we put the scope in writing.

**Do you build mobile-friendly and fast websites?**
Every website we build is responsive, tested on real phones and tuned for speed, because slow or cramped pages lose visitors and rankings.

**Is SEO included in your website design service?**
Yes. Clean semantic code, fast loading, proper titles and descriptions, structured data and a sensible URL structure are part of every build, so search engines can understand and index the site.

**Do you build websites for businesses in Canada and India?**
Yes. We design and develop websites for businesses in Bengaluru, Kochi, the Greater Toronto Area and beyond, and can write copy and set up local SEO for each market.

## Digital marketing that builds awareness and drives action
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/digital-marketing/

Pixelbrahma is a digital marketing agency with offices in Bengaluru, Kochi and Brampton that plans and manages your online channels and produces the content that makes them work.

**What does a digital marketing agency do?**
It plans, runs and measures your online promotion, including social media, paid campaigns, content and search, so more of the right people find and trust your brand.

**Do I need both media managing and content creation?**
They work best together, but you can start with one. Managing keeps channels active and measured, while content creation supplies the creative.

**Can you market to audiences in both India and Canada?**
Yes. We have teams in both countries and can adapt messaging, timing and channels for each market.

**How soon will I see results?**
Paid campaigns can show early signals within weeks, while organic growth builds over months. We set realistic expectations in the plan.

**Which digital marketing services do you offer?**
We offer digital media managing (strategy, platform management, campaign optimisation and analytics) and digital media content creation (creative, video and platform-specific posts).

**Do you run Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube marketing?**
Yes. We plan and publish content on the platforms where your customers spend time, and we recommend the right mix instead of posting everywhere.

**How do you measure digital marketing results?**
We agree the goals first, such as reach, enquiries or sales, then report the matching numbers every month with a clear note on what to do next.

## Digital media managing, from strategy to monthly insight
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/digital-media-managing/

Digital media managing means planning, running and measuring your social and paid channels, and Pixelbrahma handles all four parts: strategy, platform management, campaign optimisation and analytics.

**Which platforms do you manage?**
We agree the platforms in your strategy based on where your audience spends time. Common choices include Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn.

**Do you manage ad budgets?**
Yes. Ad spend is paid directly to the platform from your account, and we manage and optimise it for you.

**What will I see in the monthly report?**
A short summary of performance against your goals, the main lessons and the plan for the following month.

**Can you work with content we already have?**
Yes. We can schedule and optimise your existing content, or pair this service with our content creation team.

**How much does social media management cost?**
Pricing depends on the number of platforms, the posting frequency and whether paid campaigns are included. We send a written proposal after understanding your goals.

**Do you run Facebook and Instagram ads?**
Yes. We set up, monitor and optimise paid campaigns, test creatives and audiences and report cost per result in plain language.

**Can you manage social media for businesses in Kochi, Bengaluru and Canada?**
Yes. We manage channels for brands in all three regions and adapt the tone, timing and language to each audience.

**What do you need from us to get started?**
Your brand assets, access to your channels, a short brief on your goals and customers, and a named contact who can approve posts quickly.

## Content creation that tells your brand story on every platform
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/digital-media-content-creation/

Digital media content creation is the making of the posts, videos and stories your channels publish, and Pixelbrahma produces them in-house so the creative stays aligned with your brand and strategy.

**Do you shoot video on location?**
Yes, where it suits the project. We plan the shoot, crew and schedule with you in advance.

**Can you match our existing brand style?**
Yes. We follow your brand guidelines, or help you create them through our branding service.

**How many revisions are included?**
The proposal states the number of revision rounds per piece so you know what to expect.

**Can content be made in regional languages?**
We can discuss this for your project.

**What kinds of content do you create for social media?**
Static posts, carousels, short videos, reels, stories, product shots and campaign creatives, all designed for the platform they will run on.

**Do you produce video for brands in Bengaluru and Kochi?**
Yes. Our team plans, shoots and edits brand videos, product films and social video, and works with scripts, voice-over and music.

**Can you create a monthly content calendar?**
Yes. We plan topics, formats and posting dates a month ahead, so the content stays consistent and you can approve it in advance.

## Unleash your distinctiveness. Stand apart with strategic branding.
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/branding/

Pixelbrahma is a branding agency that builds distinctive brand identities and the print, packaging, retail, outdoor and broadcast materials that carry them, for businesses in India, Canada and elsewhere.

**What is branding?**
Branding is how a business is recognised and remembered: its name, logo, visual style, tone of voice and every customer experience that reflects them.

**Where should a new brand start?**
Usually with positioning and a logo, followed by the materials you will use first, such as packaging, brochures or signage.

**Can you refresh an existing brand?**
Yes. We audit what already works, keep the equity you have built and update what feels dated.

**Do you handle printing?**
We prepare production-ready artwork and can coordinate with printers.

**How much does a branding project cost?**
A branding project can be as small as a logo or as large as a complete identity with packaging, print and signage. We quote after a discovery call and put the scope in writing.

**What is included in a brand identity package?**
Typically a logo with its variations, colour palette, typography, usage guidelines and the first set of applications such as stationery, social templates or packaging.

**Do you offer branding services in Bengaluru, Kochi and Canada?**
Yes. We work with start-ups and established companies in India and Canada, and can support print production and installation in each market.

**How long does a branding project take?**
A logo can take a few weeks, a full identity usually takes longer. We agree a timeline at the start with review points after research, concepts and refinement.

## Logo design that gives your brand a face
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/logo/

A logo is the simplest mark that identifies your business wherever it appears. Pixelbrahma designs logos as part of a small identity system, so the mark works on a shop sign and a phone screen alike.

**How many logo concepts will I see?**
The proposal states the number of concepts and revision rounds, so expectations are clear from the start.

**Which file formats do I receive?**
You receive vector files for print and web-ready files for screens, organised in a labelled folder.

**Will I own the logo?**
Ownership terms are written into the agreement.

**Can you design a logo for an app?**
Yes. We design a simplified icon version that stays legible at small sizes on a phone.

**How much does logo design cost?**
It depends on the number of concepts, rounds of revisions and whether you also need a full brand identity. We quote after a short conversation about your business.

**How long does a logo design project take?**
Most logos take a few weeks, covering research, concepts, feedback and final files. We agree dates at the start.

**What makes a good logo?**
A good logo is simple, memorable, readable at small sizes and distinctive in its market, and it still works in one colour and on dark backgrounds.

**Can you redesign or refresh our existing logo?**
Yes. We can keep the recognition you have built while simplifying the shapes, fixing the colours and preparing files for print and screen.

## Brochure design that presents your story with confidence
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/brochures/

A brochure is a folded or multi-page printed piece that explains your business in more depth than a flyer can. Pixelbrahma designs brochures that guide readers from curiosity to enquiry in a few pages.

**What brochure sizes and folds can you design?**
We can design bi-fold, tri-fold, gatefold and multi-page formats, and recommend one based on your content.

**Can you write the brochure copy?**
Yes. We can write new copy or edit what you have so it fits the layout and reads clearly.

**Will you also create a digital version?**
We can export a lightweight PDF for email and your website alongside the print files.

**How much does brochure design cost?**
Cost depends on the page count, the amount of photography or illustration and whether we write the copy. We quote after seeing your content.

**Can you design a company profile or product catalogue?**
Yes. We design company profiles, product catalogues, price lists and investor decks, in print and digital formats.

**Do you supply print-ready files?**
Yes. We deliver press-ready PDFs with bleed and crop marks, and can coordinate with your printer to check proofs.

---

## Leaflet design that gets read, not tossed
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/leaftlets/

A leaflet is a single-sheet printed message handed out or posted to promote one offer, event or idea. Pixelbrahma designs leaflets that put one clear action in front of the reader within seconds.

**What is the difference between a leaflet and a brochure?**
A leaflet is usually a single sheet with one message, while a brochure has several panels or pages and goes into more detail.

**Can I add a QR code?**
Yes. We add a QR code that points to a page you control so you can track responses.

**Can one design be adapted for social media?**
Yes. We can resize the artwork into posts and stories so your campaign looks consistent.

**How much does leaflet or flyer design cost?**
A single-sided flyer costs far less than a multi-fold leaflet series. We quote after understanding the number of designs, sizes and languages.

**What size should a flyer be?**
A4, A5 and DL are the most common, and the right choice depends on how it is handed out and what it needs to say. We advise before designing.

**Can you design leaflets in Malayalam, Hindi or Kannada?**
Yes. We can set bilingual and regional-language layouts with the right fonts, as long as the final text is supplied or approved by you.

---

## Magazine design with a strong editorial voice
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/magazine/

Magazine design is the art of arranging long-form words and images into pages people want to turn. Pixelbrahma builds editorial templates and lays out issues so every edition looks like it belongs to the same publication.

**Can you design a one-off special issue?**
Yes. We can design a single edition or set up a template for a regular series.

**Do you provide a digital magazine?**
We can export an interactive-friendly PDF, and discuss web formats if you want a browser edition.

**Who writes the content?**
You can provide it, or we can help with editing and commissioning. Layout is our core focus.

**How much does magazine design cost?**
It depends on the page count, the issue frequency and whether we create a template or lay out every issue. We quote after seeing a sample of your content.

**Can you design a company newsletter or house magazine?**
Yes. We design corporate magazines, newsletters, annual reports and customer publications, in print and digital formats.

**Do you create templates our team can reuse?**
Yes. We can build a flexible layout system so your team can place new content in later issues without losing the look.

## Package design that makes your product stand out on the shelf
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/package-designs/

Package design shapes the box, pouch, bottle or label that holds your product and is often the first thing a customer sees. Pixelbrahma designs packaging that is easy to recognise, easy to read and ready for your printer.

**Can you design for my packaging supplier's dieline?**
Yes. Send the dieline and we will build the artwork to fit exactly.

**Do you help with legal text on labels?**
We make space for the required text and format it clearly. You remain responsible for confirming regulatory content with the relevant authority.

**Can you create a range with different flavours?**
Yes. We design a flexible system with a consistent layout and a distinct colour or illustration for each variant.

**Will the packaging work for online selling?**
We check that key information is legible in small product thumbnails.

**How much does packaging design cost?**
Cost depends on the number of products, pack formats and rounds of revision. We quote after discussing your range and printer.

**Can you design food, cosmetics and jewellery packaging?**
Yes. We have designed packaging and labels across food, paints, jewellery and other retail categories, and we plan the design around how each product is sold.

**Do you create packaging mock-ups?**
Yes. We show your design on realistic mock-ups before print so you can judge shelf impact and make changes early.

## In-shop branding that turns a store into a brand experience
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/inshop-branding/

In-shop branding covers the signs, displays, graphics and point-of-sale items customers see inside a store. Pixelbrahma designs them so the shopper's path from door to counter is clear and unmistakably yours.

**Do you install the signage?**
We design and supply production files, and can coordinate with fabricators.

**Can you brand several outlets consistently?**
Yes. We create a rollout guide so every location looks the same, even when spaces differ.

**Can you update seasonal offers easily?**
Yes. We design swappable templates so promotions change without a full redesign.

**What is in-shop branding?**
It is the design of everything a customer sees and touches inside a store: signage, display graphics, price cards, packaging and wayfinding.

**Do you design shop signage and display graphics?**
Yes. We create fascia signs, wall graphics, window displays, price and offer cards, and supply files ready for fabrication.

**Can you brand stores in different cities consistently?**
Yes. We create a visual guide and master artwork so every outlet looks the same, wherever it is fitted out.

---

## Outdoor branding built to be understood in three seconds
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/outdoor/

Outdoor branding is advertising seen from the street, such as hoardings, banners, vehicle wraps and building signs. Pixelbrahma designs these with large type, strong contrast and one message, because passers-by only give you moments.

**How much text should a hoarding contain?**
As little as possible. A strong image, a short headline and one contact detail usually work best.

**Can you design vehicle branding?**
Yes. We create layouts to fit vehicle templates and check how the design reads from the side, front and rear.

**Do you book the advertising space?**
Our focus is design. We can advise on formats and coordinate with media vendors you choose.

**What outdoor advertising do you design?**
Hoardings, unipoles, banners, wall graphics, bus and vehicle branding, kiosks and event signage.

**How do you make a hoarding readable at a distance?**
We use few words, strong contrast, large type and one clear message, and check the layout at the viewing distance it will be seen from.

**Can you design for different hoarding sizes?**
Yes. We adapt one idea to the different sizes and ratios you need, and provide files at the right resolution for each printer.

---

## TVCs that tell your brand's story in thirty seconds
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/tvc/

A TVC, or television commercial, is a short film that promotes your brand to a broad audience on broadcast or digital screens. Pixelbrahma develops the idea, writes the script and guides production so the final film feels like your brand, not a stock ad.

**How long is a typical TVC?**
Common lengths are 10, 20, 30 and 60 seconds. We recommend one based on your message and media plan.

**Do you buy the airtime?**
We create the film and can advise on formats. Airtime is normally booked separately through a media buyer.

**Can the same film run on YouTube and social?**
Yes. We prepare resized and shortened cuts so it works across platforms.

**How is a TVC different from social video?**
A TVC is usually a polished broadcast-quality film built around one idea, while social video is more frequent, varied and platform-native.

**How much does a TV commercial cost to produce?**
Cost varies widely with the script, locations, cast, crew and edit. We scope after a creative discussion and share a production plan and budget.

**Do you handle script, shoot and edit?**
Yes. We develop the concept and script, plan the shoot, direct and film it, and complete the edit, sound and delivery.

**Can the TVC also run online?**
Yes. We deliver the main film plus cut-downs in the formats you need for YouTube, Instagram and other channels.

## Let us talk about your project
URL: https://pixelbrahma.com/contact-us/

You can reach Pixelbrahma by phone, email or the contact form, and visit our offices in Bengaluru, Kochi and Brampton, Canada.

**How quickly will you reply to my enquiry?**
We aim to reply within one business day.

**What should I include in my message?**
A few lines about your goal, your timeline and any links or files that help. A rough budget range lets us suggest a realistic scope.

**Can we meet online instead of in person?**
Yes. Most first conversations happen by video call, and we can arrange an in-person visit at any of our offices on request.
